Build Sprint 3 of InkOS — Clients CRM + photo history + tags. Working dir: `/Users/yashbaldha/Desktop/Boldteq App/InkOS`.

**Inputs:**
- Design spec: `.handoffs/sprint-3-design-spec.md` (URL segments per tab, tag architecture, pinned-first notes, photos-by-booking, archive with undo)
- Migration handoff: `.handoffs/sprint-3-dato-migration.md`
- Migration LIVE: `supabase/migrations/20260415000005_client_crm.sql` (5 new tables: client_notes, client_tags, client_files, client_communications, client_consent_preferences; 8 new columns on clients; 2 RPCs: `get_client_profile(p_client_id)` + `bulk_tag_clients(p_client_ids, p_add, p_remove)`; new `client-files` bucket; extended `bookings` trigger updates client stats)
- Types updated: `lib/supabase/types.ts`
- Continue Sprint 1/2 design language exactly (dark theme, electric-purple, tabular-nums, skeletons not spinners, base-nova `render` not `asChild`, CSS `group-data-[collapsible=icon]:*`).

**IMPORTANT:** Another Koda is closing Sprint 2 Sage findings concurrently. Your file scope:
- DO touch: `app/(app)/clients/*`, `app/(app)/settings/tags/*`, `components/clients/*`, `app/api/clients/*` (enrich — the existing `/api/clients/search` may be modified by the concurrent Koda to fix N3; if you see unexpected changes there, merge don't overwrite), `app/api/client-notes/*`, `app/api/client-tags/*`, `app/api/client-files/*`, `app/api/client-communications/*`, `app/api/client-consent/*`
- DO NOT touch: `app/api/upload/booking-photo/route.ts`, `app/api/waitlist/*`, `app/api/public/bookings/*`, `app/book/*`, `supabase/migrations/20260415000006_*.sql` — owned by concurrent Koda
- Do NOT create new migrations — Sprint 3 migration is done

**Sprint 3 scope:**

1. **Client list** at `/clients` — DataTable with columns: avatar + name, tag chips, last_visit_at, total_spent_cents ($ formatted), total_sessions, source, preferred_contact. Debounced 300ms search via `.textSearch('fts', q, { type: 'websearch' })`. Filter chips: tag filters (multi-select from `client_tags` library), VIP, no-show alerts (`no_show_count > 0`), spending bucket, inactive >90d (`last_visit_at < now() - 90 days` OR null). Bulk actions: apply tag / remove tag (uses `bulk_tag_clients` RPC), send message (stub — log via logger.info, Sprint 4 sends), export CSV via papaparse, archive (bulk `archived_at = now()`). Show archived toggle. "+ New Client" button opens drawer. Empty states per Vega spec.

2. **New/Edit Client drawer** — Slide-in right. Sections per design spec: Basics (first_name*, last_name, email, phone, date_of_birth, preferred_contact) / Address (jsonb: street, city, state, zip, country) / Tags (multi-select from `client_tags`) / Consent prefs (marketing_email, marketing_sms, transactional_only, photo_use_portfolio, photo_use_social, data_retention_years). Minor flag auto-computed from DOB. Validate email uniqueness per studio (partial unique index in DB — catch `23505` → "A client with this email already exists"). On save: upsert `clients`, upsert `client_consent_preferences` linked to client.

3. **Client detail** at `/clients/[id]` with tab URL segments:
   - `/clients/[id]` → Overview (default). Use `get_client_profile(p_client_id)` RPC for fast load.
   - `/clients/[id]/appointments`
   - `/clients/[id]/photos`
   - `/clients/[id]/notes`
   - `/clients/[id]/files`
   - `/clients/[id]/communications`
   - `/clients/[id]/consent`
   - `/clients/[id]/financial`
   Layout `app/(app)/clients/[id]/layout.tsx` renders ClientHero + Tabs nav (shadcn Tabs with `Link` + `usePathname` — NOT the Tabs state-based API). Each page is its own server component fetching its own data.

4. **ClientHero** — avatar (photo or initials w/ brand gradient) + name + tag chips + stats pill strip (`divide-x` per spec): lifetime_value_cents · total_sessions · last_visit_at (relative) · no_show_count · member-since (created_at). `tabular-nums` throughout. CTAs: New Appointment (opens Sprint 2 drawer pre-filled with this client), Send Message (stub), Add Note, More menu (Archive/Export/Delete).

5. **Overview tab** — Pinned notes (max 3 preview with "View all") · upcoming appointments (next 3) · recent appointments (last 5) · photo grid preview (last 6 with "View all").

6. **Appointments tab** — Full paginated list of bookings for this client (reverse chronological). Reuse Sprint 2 `AppointmentStatusBadge` + `StatusTimeline`.

7. **Photos tab** — Grouped by booking (reverse chron per Vega spec), kind filter chips secondary. Lightbox on click (use `react-photo-view` or build minimal). Upload from within booking detail (already Sprint 2) — Photos tab is read-only browse.

8. **Notes tab** — Pinned section (visually separate) then category-grouped list. `AddNoteModal`: category select (8 categories from CHECK constraint) + body textarea + pin toggle. Pin/unpin inline action. Delete restricted to author or owner/admin (matches RLS). Category filter chips.

9. **Files tab** — Upload to `client-files` bucket with folder prefix `{studio_id}/{client_id}/`. List with: file_name, kind badge, size (formatBytes helper), uploaded_at, expires_at if set, download via signed URL (1hr). Delete (soft) action. MIME whitelist matches bucket config.

10. **Communications tab** — Table: timestamp, channel icon, template, subject snippet, status dot (color-coded per state), recipient. Filter by channel/status/date. Row click → detail drawer with body preview + full status timeline (sent → delivered → opened → clicked). Sprint 3 shows log only — sends come Sprint 4.

11. **Consent tab** — Edit `client_consent_preferences` (create if missing). Show version number + consented_at. Update increments version when prefs change. Per-booking consent form links (Sprint 5 placeholder section).

12. **Financial tab** — Bookings aggregation: total spent, avg session value, total tips, deposit history. Chart-light (just stats strip for Sprint 3 — full charts Sprint 12).

13. **Tag management** at `/settings/tags` — NEW settings page. Grid of existing tags (chip preview + usage count). Create/Edit form: name, color (swatch RadioGroup — 8 named brand colors), icon (lucide icon picker or preset list), description. Drag to reorder (persist via sort order). Archive tag (soft — doesn't remove from clients, just hides from picker).

14. **Archive workflow** — Archiving client sets `archived_at = now()` (soft delete). Default client list filter excludes archived. Archived clients don't appear in new-appointment client picker (update the Sprint 2 `ClientFinder` to filter `archived_at IS NULL`). Undo toast: 8-second Sonner action button "Undo" → revert `archived_at = null`.

15. **"We miss you" badge** — On dashboard + client list: clients with `last_visit_at < now() - 90 days` OR `last_visit_at IS NULL AND created_at < now() - 90 days`. Badge count → link to filtered client list. Click client → opens SMS/email template preview (stub `logger.info` send).

**API routes to create (all authed, `getAuthenticatedUser()`, `authedRatelimit`, Zod):**
- `app/api/clients/route.ts` — GET list with filters + POST create
- `app/api/clients/[id]/route.ts` — GET, PATCH, DELETE (soft via archived_at)
- `app/api/clients/[id]/restore/route.ts` — POST (undo archive)
- `app/api/clients/[id]/profile/route.ts` — GET calls `get_client_profile` RPC
- `app/api/clients/bulk-tag/route.ts` — POST calls `bulk_tag_clients` RPC
- `app/api/clients/export/route.ts` — GET streams CSV
- `app/api/client-notes/route.ts` — POST create
- `app/api/client-notes/[id]/route.ts` — PATCH (pin, body, category), DELETE (RLS enforces author/admin)
- `app/api/client-tags/route.ts` — GET list, POST create
- `app/api/client-tags/[id]/route.ts` — PATCH, DELETE
- `app/api/client-tags/reorder/route.ts` — POST sort_order bulk update
- `app/api/client-files/route.ts` — POST (upload to bucket) — multipart form
- `app/api/client-files/[id]/route.ts` — GET signed URL, DELETE
- `app/api/client-communications/route.ts` — GET list (filter by client_id, channel, status)
- `app/api/client-communications/[id]/route.ts` — GET detail
- `app/api/client-consent/[clientId]/route.ts` — GET, PUT (upserts, bumps version)

**Shared components:**
- `components/clients/ClientHero.tsx`
- `components/clients/ClientsTable.tsx`
- `components/clients/ClientDrawer.tsx` (new/edit)
- `components/clients/TagChip.tsx` (resolves slug → styled chip from client_tags library)
- `components/clients/TagPicker.tsx` (multi-select with search)
- `components/clients/StatsPillStrip.tsx`
- `components/clients/NoteCard.tsx`
- `components/clients/AddNoteModal.tsx`
- `components/clients/NotesList.tsx` (pinned + category-grouped)
- `components/clients/ClientPhotoGallery.tsx` (grouped by booking)
- `components/clients/PhotoLightbox.tsx`
- `components/clients/FileUploader.tsx`
- `components/clients/FileRow.tsx`
- `components/clients/ComsLogTable.tsx`
- `components/clients/ComsDetailDrawer.tsx`
- `components/clients/ConsentForm.tsx`
- `components/clients/MissYouBadge.tsx`
- `components/clients/BulkActionsBar.tsx`
- `components/clients/ArchiveUndoToast.tsx` (or reuse sonner action)
- `components/clients/tags/TagsManager.tsx`
- `components/clients/tags/TagForm.tsx`

**Hard rules (enforced by Sage):**
- Zero `any`, zero `console.log` (use `lib/logger.ts`), zero raw hex outside brand swatch
- `@supabase/ssr` only, `getUser()` never `getSession()`
- NEVER trust client-sent `studio_id`
- Money in cents, display via `formatCurrency`
- Every mutation → Sonner toast
- Catch `23505` uniqueness on email → clear message
- base-nova: `render` not `asChild`
- All URL-route tabs use `Link` + `usePathname`, NOT Tabs state
- `animationFillMode: "both"` on staggered lists
- File upload: MIME validation + size limit matching bucket (20MB)
- Every public table has RLS — do not bypass with service role in API routes except where intentionally audited
- Soft delete (archived_at) not DELETE for clients

**Stubs intentionally deferred:**
- Actual SMS/email sending (Sprint 4 — log via `logger.info`)
- Consent form per-booking (Sprint 5)
- Commission tie-in on financial tab (Sprint 7)
- Full analytics charts (Sprint 12)

**Pattern references:**
- `~/.claude/memory/patterns/good/ui-ux-production-standards.md`
- `~/.claude/memory/patterns/good/saas-winning-patterns.md`
- `~/.claude/memory/patterns/good/executable-validation-gates.md`
- `.handoffs/sprint-1-design-spec.md` + `.handoffs/sprint-2-design-spec.md` — continue language
- `.handoffs/sprint-3-design-spec.md` — authoritative for this sprint

**Validation (final gate — run after build complete):**
```bash
pnpm typecheck && pnpm lint && pnpm build && pnpm test
```

**Deliverables:**
1. All 4 gates green
2. Write `.handoffs/sprint-3-build-report.md` with file inventory, deviations, stubs, acceptance criteria pass/fail
3. Short summary back: file counts, blockers, anything unexpected

Do NOT touch Sprint 4+ scope. Do not create migrations. Do not touch the protected files listed above.

1	# Sprint 3 — Dato Migration Handoff
2	Migration: `20260415000005_client_crm.sql`
3	Date: 2026-04-15
4	
5	---
6	
7	## Table Inventory
8	
9	| Table | studio_id FK | Primary FK | RLS scope | Soft delete |
10	|-------|-------------|------------|-----------|-------------|
11	| `client_notes` | yes | `client_id` → clients | `user_studio_ids()` | no |
12	| `client_tags` | yes | — | `user_studio_ids()` | no |
13	| `client_files` | yes | `client_id` → clients | `user_studio_ids()` | no |
14	| `client_communications` | yes | `client_id` → clients | `user_studio_ids()` | no |
15	| `client_consent_preferences` | yes | `client_id` → clients | `user_studio_ids()` | no |
16	
17	---
18	
19	## New `clients` Columns (ADD COLUMN only — zero downtime)
20	
21	| Column | Type | Default | Trigger-maintained |
22	|--------|------|---------|-------------------|
23	| `preferred_contact` | `text CHECK (... IN ('email','sms','phone','whatsapp'))` | `'email'` | no |
24	| `referral_source` | `text` | null | no |
25	| `lifetime_value_cents` | `int NOT NULL` | `0` | yes (`update_client_crm_stats`) |
26	| `avg_session_value_cents` | `int NOT NULL` | `0` | yes (`update_client_crm_stats`) |
27	| `no_show_count` | `int NOT NULL` | `0` | yes (`update_client_crm_stats`) |
28	| `cancellation_count` | `int NOT NULL` | `0` | yes (`update_client_crm_stats`) |
29	| `loyalty_points` | `int NOT NULL` | `0` | no (app-level, Sprint 7) |
30	| `archived_at` | `timestamptz` | null | no |
31	
32	Partial index added: `idx_clients_studio_active ON clients(studio_id, archived_at) WHERE archived_at IS NULL`
33	All active-client list queries MUST include `AND archived_at IS NULL` to use this index.
34	
35	---
36	
37	## Trigger Behavior
38	
39	### `bookings_update_client_crm_stats` (NEW — fires AFTER UPDATE on `bookings`)
40	Function: `public.update_client_crm_stats()`
41	
42	Fires when `bookings.status` changes. Alphabetically after `bookings_update_client_stats` (existing), so `total_sessions` and `total_spent_cents` are already updated when this trigger reads them.
43	
44	| Transition | Effect |
45	|-----------|--------|
46	| any → `no_show` | `clients.no_show_count += 1` |
47	| `no_show` → any | `clients.no_show_count = max(0, count - 1)` |
48	| any → `cancelled` | `clients.cancellation_count += 1` |
49	| `cancelled` → any | `clients.cancellation_count = max(0, count - 1)` |
50	| any → `completed` | recomputes `lifetime_value_cents` and `avg_session_value_cents` from fresh `total_spent_cents / total_sessions` |
51	| `completed` → any | same recompute (correction scenario) |
52	
53	`lifetime_value_cents` mirrors `total_spent_cents` — they're intentionally kept in sync so the client profile RPC has a single field to read rather than deriving it.
54	
55	---
56	
57	## Storage Bucket: `client-files`
58	
59	| Property | Value |
60	|----------|-------|
61	| Bucket ID | `client-files` |
62	| Public | false |
63	| Max file size | 20 MB (20,971,520 bytes) |
64	| Allowed MIME types | `application/pdf`, `image/jpeg`, `image/png`, `image/heic`, `image/heif` |
65	| Path convention | `{studio_id}/{client_id}/{uuid}.ext` |
66	| Anon access | none |
67	
68	Storage RLS policies created: `client_files_bucket_select`, `client_files_bucket_insert`, `client_files_bucket_delete`.
69	
70	The `(storage.foldername(name))[1]` extracts the first path segment (studio_id). Koda must always upload to `{studio_id}/{client_id}/{filename}` paths — the bucket policy enforces studio isolation on the first segment only.
71	
72	To generate a signed read URL (do NOT expose storage_path directly):
73	```ts
74	const { data } = await supabase.storage
75	  .from('client-files')
76	  .createSignedUrl(storagePath, 3600) // 1-hour TTL
77	```
78	
79	---
80	
81	## RPC Contracts
82	
83	### `public.get_client_profile(p_client_id uuid) RETURNS jsonb`
84	- Authenticated only — returns `{ error: 'unauthenticated' }` for anon.
85	- Returns `{ error: 'not_found' }` if client_id is outside the caller's studios.
86	- Returns a single jsonb object with:
87	  - All client fields including Sprint 3 additions
88	  - `pinned_notes`: array of up to 10 pinned `client_notes` rows (id, category, body, is_pinned, author_id, created_at)
89	  - `consent_preferences`: object from `client_consent_preferences` (null keys if no row yet)
90	  - `booking_count`: int
91	  - `photo_count`: int (from `booking_photos`)
92	  - `file_count`: int (from `client_files`)
93	- TypeScript: `await supabase.rpc('get_client_profile', { p_client_id: id })`
94	
95	### `public.bulk_tag_clients(p_client_ids uuid[], p_tags_to_add text[], p_tags_to_remove text[]) RETURNS int`
96	- Authenticated only — raises exception for anon.
97	- Raises `forbidden` exception if any client_id is outside the caller's studios.
98	- Returns count of rows updated (0 if empty input).
99	- Tag mutation is atomic: adds first, then removes. Deduplicates result.
100	- Either `p_tags_to_add` or `p_tags_to_remove` may be empty arrays `'{}'` — both being empty is a no-op that still returns 0.
101	- TypeScript:
102	  ```ts
103	  const { data } = await supabase.rpc('bulk_tag_clients', {
104	    p_client_ids: ['uuid1', 'uuid2'],
105	    p_tags_to_add: ['VIP', 'Referral'],
106	    p_tags_to_remove: ['New'],
107	  })
108	  // data: number (rows updated)
109	  ```
110	
111	---
112	
113	## RLS Summary
114	
115	| Table | SELECT | INSERT | UPDATE | DELETE |
116	|-------|--------|--------|--------|--------|
117	| `client_notes` | studio member | studio member | studio member | author OR owner/admin |
118	| `client_tags` | studio member | studio member | studio member | owner/admin/receptionist |
119	| `client_files` | studio member | studio member | studio member | owner/admin/receptionist |
120	| `client_communications` | studio member | studio member | studio member | owner/admin |
121	| `client_consent_preferences` | studio member | studio member | studio member | owner/admin |
122	
123	"studio member" = `studio_id = ANY(public.user_studio_ids())`.
124	
125	---
126	
127	## Koda Gotchas
128	
129	1. **`client_notes.fts` is a GENERATED column** — never include it in Insert/Update. Use it only in SQL `WHERE fts @@ to_tsquery(...)` via `.textSearch()` or `.rpc()`.
130	
131	2. **`client_tags` UNIQUE constraint is on `lower(name)`** — when checking for duplicate tag names use case-insensitive comparison: `name.toLowerCase()` before calling insert.
132	
133	3. **`client_consent_preferences` is 1-per-client** — use `.upsert()` with `{ onConflict: 'client_id' }` not `.insert()`. Inserting twice will throw a unique constraint violation.
134	
135	4. **`clients.archived_at` soft delete** — ALL client list queries must filter `archived_at IS NULL` (active clients) or `archived_at IS NOT NULL` (archived). Never query without this filter or you'll show archived clients.
136	
137	5. **`get_client_profile` returns jsonb** — the result is not type-inferred by the Supabase client. Cast it explicitly:
138	   ```ts
139	   type ClientProfile = { id: string; first_name: string; ... }
140	   const { data } = await supabase.rpc('get_client_profile', { p_client_id: id })
141	   const profile = data as ClientProfile
142	   ```
143	
144	6. **Storage signed URLs required** — `client_files.storage_path` is a private bucket path. Never render it as-is. Always call `createSignedUrl()` with a short TTL (≤3600s).
145	
146	7. **`client_communications` is append-only by design** — Sprint 4 worker inserts rows here; the app updates `status`, `delivered_at`, `opened_at` via webhook. Do not let the UI insert 'sent' status rows directly — they must start as 'queued'.
147	
148	8. **`bulk_tag_clients` raises on forbidden** — wrap in try/catch. A mixed selection of clients from different studios will throw, not return 0.
149	
150	9. **Trigger ordering** — `bookings_update_client_crm_stats` fires AFTER `bookings_update_client_stats`. This means when reading `total_spent_cents` and `total_sessions` inside the CRM trigger, they already reflect the current booking's contribution. Do not re-derive these in app code.
151	
152	10. **`client_files` bucket path isolation** — the storage policy reads `(storage.foldername(name))[1]` as the studio_id. Upload paths MUST be `{studio_id}/{client_id}/{filename}`. A flat path like `{filename}` will be rejected by the policy.
153

1	# InkOS — Project Context for Claude Code
2	
3	**Stack:** A (Next.js 16.2.3 + Supabase + Railway + Dodo Payments)
4	**Status:** Sprint 0 complete — scaffold ready
5	**Scaffolded by:** Riko on 2026-04-15
6	**Build plan:** `~/.claude/plans/immutable-conjuring-pelican.md` (12 sprints, 24 weeks)
7	
8	---
9	
10	## What InkOS Is
11	
12	Multi-tenant tattoo studio management SaaS. Authenticated web app only (no marketing pages in v1). 4-tier pricing (Solo $29 / Studio $59 / Pro $99 / Enterprise $199). Multi-user from day 1 (owners + artists + receptionists). 12-sprint build targeting first paying studios at 24 weeks.
13	
14	---
15	
16	## Forbidden (Sage hard-fails)
17	
18	- `@supabase/auth-helpers-nextjs` — use `@supabase/ssr`
19	- Vercel — use Railway
20	- Stripe — use Dodo Payments
21	- NextAuth — use Supabase Auth
22	- Prisma or any ORM — use Supabase client + generated types
23	- Pages Router — App Router only
24	- npm / yarn — pnpm only
25	- CSS modules — Tailwind only
26	- `any` TypeScript type — zero exceptions
27	- `console.log` — use `lib/logger.ts` (pino)
28	- Raw hex colors except `--color-ink-black` and `--color-electric-purple` in `globals.css`
29	- `tailwind.config.ts` — Tailwind 4 uses `@theme inline` in `globals.css` only
30	- Default Tailwind shadows (`shadow-sm`, `shadow-md`) — use `shadow-soft`, `shadow-card`, `shadow-soft-md`
31	
32	---
33	
34	## Key Architecture Decisions
35	
36	1. **Next.js 16 uses `proxy.ts` not `middleware.ts`** — the file is at the project root, not in `app/`
37	2. **`instrumentation-client.ts` is REQUIRED** — missing this = no browser errors in Sentry
38	3. **`cookies()` is async in Next.js 16** — always `await cookies()`
39	4. **Worker packages must NEVER import `next/*`** — separate `package.json` in `workers/`
40	5. **BullMQ ioredis requires `maxRetriesPerRequest: null`** — silent failure without it
41	6. **Supabase service-role client bypasses RLS** — only use in webhook handlers + admin ops
42	7. **Webhook handler uses `timingSafeEqual`** — constant-time HMAC comparison, never `===`
43	8. **Subscriptions table is write-only by webhook** — no app code writes to it directly
44	9. **Tailwind 4 — no `tailwind.config.ts`** — all tokens in `app/globals.css` `@theme inline`
45

291	## 5. URL Structure — Client Detail Tabs
292	
293	### Decision: URL segments, NOT query params
294	
295	Route: `app/(app)/clients/[id]/[tab]/page.tsx`
296	
297	```
298	/clients/[id]                → redirect to /clients/[id]/overview
299	/clients/[id]/overview       → OverviewTab (default)
300	/clients/[id]/appointments   → ClientAppointmentsTab
301	/clients/[id]/photos         → ClientPhotosTab
302	/clients/[id]/notes          → ClientNotesTab
303	/clients/[id]/files          → ClientFilesTab
304	/clients/[id]/comms          → ClientCommsTab
305	/clients/[id]/consent        → ClientConsentTab
306	/clients/[id]/financial      → ClientFinancialTab
307	```
308	
309	**Why segments over `?tab=`:**
310	1. Back button navigates between tabs correctly (each tab = a real history entry).
311	2. CommandPalette can deep-link to `/clients/[id]/notes` — works with segments, breaks with params.
312	3. Server components can read `params.tab` in the page component to fetch only what's needed.
313	4. No hydration mismatch risk from URL state vs component state.
314	
315	**Layout file:** `app/(app)/clients/[id]/layout.tsx` — Server Component. Fetches client hero data (`id, first_name, last_name, tags, total_spent_cents, total_sessions, last_visit_at, no_show_count, created_at, preferred_contact, archived_at`). Renders `<ClientHero>` + `<ClientTabNav>` + `{children}`. The hero + tabs stay mounted across tab navigations (layout doesn't re-render).
316	
317	**`ClientTabNav` active state:** `usePathname()` determines active tab from the last segment. Uses standard `[data-active="true"]` pattern consistent with sidebar — NOT the shadcn `Tabs` component (which uses internal state and would fight the URL). Koda builds it as a nav row with individual links.

import { type ClassValue, clsx } from 'clsx'
import { twMerge } from 'tailwind-merge'

/**
 * Merge Tailwind CSS class names without conflicts.
 */
export function cn(...inputs: ClassValue[]) {
  return twMerge(clsx(inputs))
}

/**
 * Format a currency amount from cents to a display string.
 */
export function formatCurrency(cents: number, currency = 'USD', locale = 'en-US'): string {
  return new Intl.NumberFormat(locale, {
    style: 'currency',
    currency,
    minimumFractionDigits: 0,
    maximumFractionDigits: 2,
  }).format(cents / 100)
}

/**
 * Format a date for display.
 */
export function formatDate(date: Date | string, options?: Intl.DateTimeFormatOptions): string {
  const d = typeof date === 'string' ? new Date(date) : date
  return new Intl.DateTimeFormat('en-US', {
    year: 'numeric',
    month: 'short',
    day: 'numeric',
    ...options,
  }).format(d)
}

/**
 * Generate a URL-safe slug from a string.
 */
export function slugify(input: string): string {
  return input
    .toLowerCase()
    .trim()
    .replace(/[^\w\s-]/g, '')
    .replace(/[\s_-]+/g, '-')
    .replace(/^-+|-+$/g, '')
}

/**
 * Truncate a string to a maximum length with an ellipsis.
 */
export function truncate(str: string, maxLength: number): string {
  if (str.length <= maxLength) return str
  return `${str.slice(0, maxLength - 3)}...`
}

/**
 * Type guard to check if a value is a non-null object.
 */
export function isObject(value: unknown): value is Record<string, unknown> {
  return typeof value === 'object' && value !== null && !Array.isArray(value)
}

9

11	  children: React.ReactNode
12	}

14	export default async function AppLayout({ children }: AppLayoutProps) {
15	  const supabase = await createClient()
16	  const {
17	    data: { user },
18	  } = await supabase.auth.getUser()
19	
20	  if (!user) {
21	    redirect('/login')
22	  }
23	
24	  // Fetch profile, studio membership, and studio in parallel
25	  const [profileResult, memberResult] = await Promise.all([
26	    supabase
27	      .from('profiles')
28	      .select('full_name, avatar_url')
29	      .eq('id', user.id)
30	      .single(),
31	    supabase
32	      .from('studio_members')
33	      .select('role, studio_id, studios(id, name, slug, logo_url, plan_id)')
34	      .eq('user_id', user.id)
35	      .order('created_at', { ascending: true })
36	      .limit(1)
37	      .single(),
38	  ])
39	
40	  // Graceful fallbacks — layout must never crash
41	  const profile = profileResult.data
42	  const member = memberResult.data
43	
44	  const studioName = (member?.studios as { name: string } | null)?.name ?? 'My Studio'
45	  const studioLogoUrl =
46	    (member?.studios as { logo_url: string | null } | null)?.logo_url ?? null
47	  const studioId = member?.studio_id ?? null
48	  const role: NavRole =
49	    (member?.role as NavRole | undefined) ?? 'owner'
50	
51	  // Subscription / plan
52	  let plan: PlanTier = 'solo'
53	  if (studioId) {
54	    const subResult = await supabase
55	      .from('subscriptions')
56	      .select('plan_tier')
57	      .eq('studio_id', studioId)
58	      .eq('status', 'active')
59	      .maybeSingle()
60	    if (subResult.data?.plan_tier) {

2	import { cookies } from 'next/headers'
3	import { cache } from 'react'
4	import type { Database } from './types'
5	
6	type StudioRole = Database['public']['Tables']['studio_members']['Row']['role']
7	
8	export interface AuthenticatedUser {
9	  user: Database['public']['Tables']['profiles']['Row'] & { authId: string }
10	  studioId: string
11	  role: StudioRole
12	}
13

15	/**
16	 * Server Supabase client for Server Components, API Route Handlers, and Server Actions.
17	 *
18	 * Uses the anon key + user session cookies.
19	 * RLS policies apply based on the authenticated user.
20	 *
21	 * IMPORTANT: cookies() is async in Next.js 16 — must be awaited.
22	 */
23	export async function createClient() {
24	  const cookieStore = await cookies()
25	
26	  return createServerClient<Database>(
27	    process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL!,
28	    process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY!,
29	    {
30	      cookies: {
31	        getAll() {
32	          return cookieStore.getAll()
33	        },
34	        setAll(cookiesToSet) {
35	          try {
36	            cookiesToSet.forEach(({ name, value, options }) =>
37	              cookieStore.set(name, value, options)
38	            )
39	          } catch {
40	            // setAll called from a Server Component — cookies cannot be set
41	            // middleware handles session refresh
42	          }
43	        },
44	      },
45	    }
46	  )
47	}
48	
49	/**
50	 * Cached helper that validates the session and returns the authenticated user
51	 * together with their primary studio context.
52	 *
53	 * Wrapped in React cache() so repeated calls within the same render tree
54	 * (e.g. layout + page) are deduplicated — only one round-trip per request.
55	 *
56	 * Returns null when the user is not authenticated or has no studio membership.
57	 */
58	export const getAuthenticatedUser = cache(async (): Promise<AuthenticatedUser | null> => {
59	  const supabase = await createClient()
60	  const { data: { user }, error: authError } = await supabase.auth.getUser()
61	
62	  if (authError || !user) return null
63	
64	  const [profileResult, memberResult] = await Promise.all([
65	    supabase
66	      .from('profiles')
67	      .select('id, email, full_name, avatar_url, is_platform_admin, created_at, updated_at')
68	      .eq('id', user.id)
69	      .single(),
70	    supabase
71	      .from('studio_members')
72	      .select('studio_id, role')
73	      .eq('user_id', user.id)
74	      .order('created_at', { ascending: true })
75	      .limit(1)
76	      .single(),
77	  ])
78	
79	  if (profileResult.error || !profileResult.data) return null
80	  if (memberResult.error || !memberResult.data) return null
81	
82	  return {
83	    user: { ...profileResult.data, authId: user.id },
84	    studioId: memberResult.data.studio_id,
85	    role: memberResult.data.role,
86	  }
87	})

90	 * Service-role Supabase client for webhook handlers and admin operations.
91	 *
92	 * Bypasses RLS. NEVER expose to client. Only use server-side.
93	 */
94	export function createServiceRoleClient() {

96	  if (!serviceRoleKey) {

98	  }

100	  return createServerClient<Database>(

102	    serviceRoleKey,
103	    {
104	      cookies: {
105	        getAll() {
106	          return []
107	        },
108	        setAll() {
109	          // No-op for service role — no session cookies
110	        },
111	      },
112	      auth: {
113	        autoRefreshToken: false,
114	        persistSession: false,
115	      },
116	    }
117	  )

1	# InkOS — Project Context for Claude Code
2	
3	**Stack:** A (Next.js 16.2.3 + Supabase + Railway + Dodo Payments)
4	**Status:** Sprint 0 complete — scaffold ready
5	**Scaffolded by:** Riko on 2026-04-15
6	**Build plan:** `~/.claude/plans/immutable-conjuring-pelican.md` (12 sprints, 24 weeks)
7	
8	---
9	
10	## What InkOS Is
11	
12	Multi-tenant tattoo studio management SaaS. Authenticated web app only (no marketing pages in v1). 4-tier pricing (Solo $29 / Studio $59 / Pro $99 / Enterprise $199). Multi-user from day 1 (owners + artists + receptionists). 12-sprint build targeting first paying studios at 24 weeks.
13	
14	---
15	
16	## Forbidden (Sage hard-fails)
17	
18	- `@supabase/auth-helpers-nextjs` — use `@supabase/ssr`
19	- Vercel — use Railway
20	- Stripe — use Dodo Payments
21	- NextAuth — use Supabase Auth
22	- Prisma or any ORM — use Supabase client + generated types
23	- Pages Router — App Router only
24	- npm / yarn — pnpm only
25	- CSS modules — Tailwind only
26	- `any` TypeScript type — zero exceptions
27	- `console.log` — use `lib/logger.ts` (pino)
28	- Raw hex colors except `--color-ink-black` and `--color-electric-purple` in `globals.css`
29	- `tailwind.config.ts` — Tailwind 4 uses `@theme inline` in `globals.css` only
30	- Default Tailwind shadows (`shadow-sm`, `shadow-md`) — use `shadow-soft`, `shadow-card`, `shadow-soft-md`
31	
32	---
33	
34	## Key Architecture Decisions
35	
36	1. **Next.js 16 uses `proxy.ts` not `middleware.ts`** — the file is at the project root, not in `app/`
37	2. **`instrumentation-client.ts` is REQUIRED** — missing this = no browser errors in Sentry
38	3. **`cookies()` is async in Next.js 16** — always `await cookies()`
39	4. **Worker packages must NEVER import `next/*`** — separate `package.json` in `workers/`
40	5. **BullMQ ioredis requires `maxRetriesPerRequest: null`** — silent failure without it
41	6. **Supabase service-role client bypasses RLS** — only use in webhook handlers + admin ops
42	7. **Webhook handler uses `timingSafeEqual`** — constant-time HMAC comparison, never `===`
43	8. **Subscriptions table is write-only by webhook** — no app code writes to it directly
44	9. **Tailwind 4 — no `tailwind.config.ts`** — all tokens in `app/globals.css` `@theme inline`
45	
46	---
47	
48	## Folder Structure (top-level)
49	
50	```
51	app/
52	  (auth)/          login, signup, forgot-password, reset-password, callback, onboarding
53	  (app)/           all authenticated pages — sidebar wrapper

69	  logger.ts        pino structured logger
70	  audit.ts         logAuditAction() helper

72	
73	proxy.ts           Next.js 16 session middleware (was middleware.ts in 15)
74	instrumentation.ts Sentry server init
75	instrumentation-client.ts Sentry browser init (REQUIRED)

14	export function formatCurrency(cents: number, currency = 'USD', locale = 'en-US'): string {
15	  return new Intl.NumberFormat(locale, {
16	    style: 'currency',
17	    currency,
18	    minimumFractionDigits: 0,
19	    maximumFractionDigits: 2,
20	  }).format(cents / 100)
21	}

27	  const d = typeof date === 'string' ? new Date(date) : date
28	  return new Intl.DateTimeFormat('en-US', {
29	    year: 'numeric',
30	    month: 'short',
31	    day: 'numeric',
32	    ...options,
33	  }).format(d)
34	}

36	/**
37	 * Generate a URL-safe slug from a string.
38	 */
39	export function slugify(input: string): string {
40	  return input
41	    .toLowerCase()
42	    .trim()
43	    .replace(/[^\w\s-]/g, '')
44	    .replace(/[\s_-]+/g, '-')
45	    .replace(/^-+|-+$/g, '')
46	}

48	/**
49	 * Truncate a string to a maximum length with an ellipsis.
50	 */
51	export function truncate(str: string, maxLength: number): string {
52	  if (str.length <= maxLength) return str
53	  return `${str.slice(0, maxLength - 3)}...`
54	}

56	/**
57	 * Type guard to check if a value is a non-null object.
58	 */
59	export function isObject(value: unknown): value is Record<string, unknown> {
60	  return typeof value === 'object' && value !== null && !Array.isArray(value)
61	}

63	/**
64	 * Format bytes to a human-readable string.
65	 */
66	export function formatBytes(bytes: number, decimals = 1): string {
67	  if (bytes === 0) return '0 B'
68	  const k = 1024
69	  const sizes = ['B', 'KB', 'MB', 'GB']
70	  const i = Math.floor(Math.log(bytes) / Math.log(k))
71	  return `${parseFloat((bytes / Math.pow(k, i)).toFixed(decimals))} ${sizes[i]}`
72	}

74	/**
75	 * Format a relative time label (e.g. "3 days ago", "Apr 14").
76	 */
77	export function formatRelativeTime(date: Date | string | null | undefined): string {
78	  if (!date) return 'Never'
79	  const d = typeof date === 'string' ? new Date(date) : date
80	  const now = new Date()
81	  const diffMs = now.getTime() - d.getTime()
82	  const diffDays = Math.floor(diffMs / (1000 * 60 * 60 * 24))
83	  if (diffDays === 0) return 'Today'
84	  if (diffDays === 1) return 'Yesterday'
85	  if (diffDays < 7) return `${diffDays} days ago`
86	  if (diffDays < 365) {
87	    return d.toLocaleDateString('en-US', { month: 'short', day: 'numeric' })
88	  }

291	## 5. URL Structure — Client Detail Tabs
292	
293	### Decision: URL segments, NOT query params
294	
295	Route: `app/(app)/clients/[id]/[tab]/page.tsx`
296	
297	```
298	/clients/[id]                → redirect to /clients/[id]/overview
299	/clients/[id]/overview       → OverviewTab (default)
300	/clients/[id]/appointments   → ClientAppointmentsTab
301	/clients/[id]/photos         → ClientPhotosTab
302	/clients/[id]/notes          → ClientNotesTab
303	/clients/[id]/files          → ClientFilesTab
304	/clients/[id]/comms          → ClientCommsTab
305	/clients/[id]/consent        → ClientConsentTab
306	/clients/[id]/financial      → ClientFinancialTab
307	```
308	
309	**Why segments over `?tab=`:**
310	1. Back button navigates between tabs correctly (each tab = a real history entry).
311	2. CommandPalette can deep-link to `/clients/[id]/notes` — works with segments, breaks with params.
312	3. Server components can read `params.tab` in the page component to fetch only what's needed.
313	4. No hydration mismatch risk from URL state vs component state.
314	
315	**Layout file:** `app/(app)/clients/[id]/layout.tsx` — Server Component. Fetches client hero data (`id, first_name, last_name, tags, total_spent_cents, total_sessions, last_visit_at, no_show_count, created_at, preferred_contact, archived_at`). Renders `<ClientHero>` + `<ClientTabNav>` + `{children}`. The hero + tabs stay mounted across tab navigations (layout doesn't re-render).
316	
317	**`ClientTabNav` active state:** `usePathname()` determines active tab from the last segment. Uses standard `[data-active="true"]` pattern consistent with sidebar — NOT the shadcn `Tabs` component (which uses internal state and would fight the URL). Koda builds it as a nav row with individual links.

15	/**
16	 * Server Supabase client for Server Components, API Route Handlers, and Server Actions.
17	 *
18	 * Uses the anon key + user session cookies.
19	 * RLS policies apply based on the authenticated user.
20	 *
21	 * IMPORTANT: cookies() is async in Next.js 16 — must be awaited.
22	 */
23	export async function createClient() {
24	  const cookieStore = await cookies()
25	
26	  return createServerClient<Database>(
27	    process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL!,
28	    process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY!,
29	    {
30	      cookies: {
31	        getAll() {
32	          return cookieStore.getAll()
33	        },
34	        setAll(cookiesToSet) {
35	          try {
36	            cookiesToSet.forEach(({ name, value, options }) =>
37	              cookieStore.set(name, value, options)
38	            )
39	          } catch {
40	            // setAll called from a Server Component — cookies cannot be set
41	            // middleware handles session refresh
42	          }
43	        },
44	      },
45	    }
46	  )
47	}
48	
49	/**
50	 * Cached helper that validates the session and returns the authenticated user
51	 * together with their primary studio context.
52	 *
53	 * Wrapped in React cache() so repeated calls within the same render tree
54	 * (e.g. layout + page) are deduplicated — only one round-trip per request.
55	 *
56	 * Returns null when the user is not authenticated or has no studio membership.
57	 */
58	export const getAuthenticatedUser = cache(async (): Promise<AuthenticatedUser | null> => {
59	  const supabase = await createClient()
60	  const { data: { user }, error: authError } = await supabase.auth.getUser()
61	
62	  if (authError || !user) return null
63	
64	  const [profileResult, memberResult] = await Promise.all([
65	    supabase
66	      .from('profiles')
67	      .select('id, email, full_name, avatar_url, is_platform_admin, created_at, updated_at')
68	      .eq('id', user.id)
69	      .single(),
70	    supabase
71	      .from('studio_members')
72	      .select('studio_id, role')
73	      .eq('user_id', user.id)
74	      .order('created_at', { ascending: true })
75	      .limit(1)
76	      .single(),
77	  ])
78	
79	  if (profileResult.error || !profileResult.data) return null
80	  if (memberResult.error || !memberResult.data) return null
81	
82	  return {
83	    user: { ...profileResult.data, authId: user.id },
84	    studioId: memberResult.data.studio_id,
85	    role: memberResult.data.role,
86	  }
87	})

This session is being continued from a previous conversation that ran out of context. The summary below covers the earlier portion of the conversation.

Summary:
1. Primary Request and Intent:
   Koda is building Sprint 3 of InkOS — a multi-tenant tattoo studio management SaaS (Stack A: Next.js 16.2.3 + Supabase + Railway). Sprint 3 covers the full Clients CRM with DataTable, filters, bulk actions, archive/undo, CSV export; New/Edit Client drawer (5-section form); Client detail page at `/clients/[id]` with 8 URL-segment tabs (Overview, Appointments, Photos, Notes, Files, Comms, Consent, Financial); ClientHero; Photos tab with lightbox; Notes tab; Files tab; Communications tab (read-only); Consent tab (GDPR); Financial tab; Tag management at `/settings/tags`; archive workflow with undo toast; and all corresponding API routes. The migration is already live, types updated, and the build is running concurrently with Sprint 2 Sage fixes (do not touch `app/api/clients/search/route.ts`).

2. Key Technical Concepts:
   - Stack A: Next.js 16.2.3 (App Router), React 19, TypeScript strict, Tailwind 4, shadcn base-nova, Supabase (`@supabase/ssr`), Railway
   - `createClient()` and `getAuthenticatedUser()` from `lib/supabase/server.ts` — `await cookies()` required (Next.js 16 async)
   - URL-segment tabs for client detail (NOT query params) — `usePathname()` drives active state
   - Soft delete via `archived_at TIMESTAMPTZ` — never hard DELETE on clients
   - `get_client_profile` RPC returns jsonb — not used in layout, individual column select used instead
   - `client-files` bucket (private, 20MB max) — signed URLs only
   - `client_notes.fts` is GENERATED — never include in Insert/Update
   - `client_consent_preferences` — upsert with `{ onConflict: 'client_id' }`
   - `client_communications` — append-only, GET only in Sprint 3
   - Tailwind 4 — `@theme inline` in `globals.css` only, no `tailwind.config.ts`
   - `formatCurrency(cents)` from `lib/utils.ts` — only way to render money; `tabular-nums` on all money/count
   - Sonner toasts on every mutation (success + error)
   - Zod on every API route, `authedRatelimit`/`expensiveRatelimit` on every route
   - pino logger (`lib/logger.ts`) — zero `console.log`
   - shadcn base-nova: `render` prop on `DropdownMenuTrigger` (not `asChild`)
   - `animationFillMode: "both"` on staggered lists
   - `@dnd-kit/core/sortable/utilities` for drag-to-reorder tag library
   - papaparse for CSV export
   - Tag color system: 8 named colors with `.tag-chip-{color}` CSS classes
   - Note categories: 8 types with `.note-dot-{category}` CSS classes
   - `client-avatar-hero` CSS class for gradient initials avatar
   - `client-row-inactive` / `client-row-archived` CSS classes
   - date-fns `differenceInYears` for computing minor status from DOB
   - XHR (not fetch) for file uploads to track progress

3. Files and Code Sections:

   **Previously built (prior session — already complete):**
   - `app/globals.css` — Sprint 3 tokens added (`--color-tag-*`, `--color-hero-gradient-*`, etc.) + `@layer components` classes

   - `components/clients/photos/KindFilterToggle.tsx`
     - ToggleGroup for photo kind filter (reference/before/during/after/healed)


   - `components/clients/photos/PhotoGroup.tsx`
     - Per-booking photo group with header (booking date · service · artist) and grid

1	# InkOS — Project Context for Claude Code
2	
3	**Stack:** A (Next.js 16.2.3 + Supabase + Railway + Dodo Payments)
4	**Status:** Sprint 0 complete — scaffold ready
5	**Scaffolded by:** Riko on 2026-04-15
6	**Build plan:** `~/.claude/plans/immutable-conjuring-pelican.md` (12 sprints, 24 weeks)
7	
8	---
9	
10	## What InkOS Is
11	
12	Multi-tenant tattoo studio management SaaS. Authenticated web app only (no marketing pages in v1). 4-tier pricing (Solo $29 / Studio $59 / Pro $99 / Enterprise $199). Multi-user from day 1 (owners + artists + receptionists). 12-sprint build targeting first paying studios at 24 weeks.
13	
14	---
15	
16	## Forbidden (Sage hard-fails)
17	
18	- `@supabase/auth-helpers-nextjs` — use `@supabase/ssr`
19	- Vercel — use Railway
20	- Stripe — use Dodo Payments
21	- NextAuth — use Supabase Auth
22	- Prisma or any ORM — use Supabase client + generated types
23	- Pages Router — App Router only
24	- npm / yarn — pnpm only
25	- CSS modules — Tailwind only
26	- `any` TypeScript type — zero exceptions
27	- `console.log` — use `lib/logger.ts` (pino)
28	- Raw hex colors except `--color-ink-black` and `--color-electric-purple` in `globals.css`
29	- `tailwind.config.ts` — Tailwind 4 uses `@theme inline` in `globals.css` only
30	- Default Tailwind shadows (`shadow-sm`, `shadow-md`) — use `shadow-soft`, `shadow-card`, `shadow-soft-md`
31	
32	---
33	
34	## Key Architecture Decisions
35	
36	1. **Next.js 16 uses `proxy.ts` not `middleware.ts`** — the file is at the project root, not in `app/`
37	2. **`instrumentation-client.ts` is REQUIRED** — missing this = no browser errors in Sentry
38	3. **`cookies()` is async in Next.js 16** — always `await cookies()`
39	4. **Worker packages must NEVER import `next/*`** — separate `package.json` in `workers/`
40	5. **BullMQ ioredis requires `maxRetriesPerRequest: null`** — silent failure without it
41	6. **Supabase service-role client bypasses RLS** — only use in webhook handlers + admin ops
42	7. **Webhook handler uses `timingSafeEqual`** — constant-time HMAC comparison, never `===`
43	8. **Subscriptions table is write-only by webhook** — no app code writes to it directly
44	9. **Tailwind 4 — no `tailwind.config.ts`** — all tokens in `app/globals.css` `@theme inline`
45	
46	---
47	
48	## Folder Structure (top-level)
49	
50	```
51	app/
52	  (auth)/          login, signup, forgot-password, reset-password, callback, onboarding
53	  (app)/           all authenticated pages — sidebar wrapper
54	  admin/           admin panel (Sprint 12)
55	  api/
56	    health/        Railway healthcheck
57	    webhooks/dodo/ Dodo Payments webhook
58	  book/[studioSlug]/ PUBLIC client-facing booking (Sprint 2)
59	  globals.css      Tailwind 4 @theme inline — Vega owns tokens
60	  layout.tsx       Root: ThemeProvider + Toaster + fonts
61	
62	lib/
63	  env.ts           Zod boot-time validation
64	  supabase/        client.ts, server.ts, middleware.ts, types.ts
65	  dodo/            client.ts (Dodo Payments SDK)
66	  rate-limit.ts    Upstash: apiRatelimit, authedRatelimit, expensiveRatelimit
67	  cache.ts         Upstash Redis get/set/bust
68	  queue.ts         BullMQ enqueuer (web never processes jobs)
69	  logger.ts        pino structured logger
70	  audit.ts         logAuditAction() helper
71	  utils.ts         cn(), formatCurrency(), slugify()
72	
73	proxy.ts           Next.js 16 session middleware (was middleware.ts in 15)
74	instrumentation.ts Sentry server init
75	instrumentation-client.ts Sentry browser init (REQUIRED)
76	
77	workers/
78	  jobs/            BullMQ worker service (separate Railway service)
79	  cron/            node-cron scheduler (separate Railway service)
80	
81	supabase/
82	  migrations/      SQL migrations — Dato owns
83	  config.toml      Supabase CLI config with branching enabled
84	```
